editorial:
Imagine a girl who is totally fine with being the odd one out. You get to follow Brenda Miller, a girl who is awkward and chubby but has a level of confidence that most adults wish they had. The movie jumps back and forth between her time as a wild 13-year-old and her life as a 31-year-old woman. It is a funny, sweet look at how some people just never change their weird ways, and honestly, that is the best part about her. You will feel like you are looking through an old photo album that actually talks back to you.

The acting is spot on, and the way the story flips between the past and present keeps things moving quickly. While some of the humor is a bit random, it mostly just adds to the charm of Brenda's personality. If you love stories about outsiders who refuse to fit in, you need to see this.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up by showing that Brenda has not changed much, and that is why she is happy. After seeing all the chaos of her youth and the struggles of her adult years, she accepts that she will always be a bit strange. She finds a sense of peace with who she is. The final scenes show her embracing her unique personality, proving that staying true to yourself is the only way to actually win at life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves oddball characters and heartwarming comedies.
